title: Edit Ledger Transaction in Ledgers
description: Complete the edit ledger transaction workflow in the Ledgers module using a validated, repeatable process.
prerequisites: You are signed in with accountant access or equivalent permissions.
You can open the Ledgers module in the current Ogeemo environment.
Required data inputs for edit ledger transaction are prepared before starting.
steps: Open Accounting and select BKS General Ledger.
Use account and date filters to load the target ledger view.
Perform the requested ledger action for the selected records.
Validate resulting balances, transaction state, and posting status.
Capture change references and audit evidence.
Escalate any permission or lock errors through ledger recovery steps.
validations: Edit Ledger Transaction completes without warnings or blockers.
Resulting records are visible in the expected Ledgers views.
Any generated output is stored in the expected location with traceable metadata.
commonErrors: Required fields are missing during edit ledger transaction.
Permission constraints prevent completion of edit ledger transaction.
Output is created but not linked to the expected workflow context.
recovery: Validate required field inputs and rerun edit ledger transaction.
Confirm role permissions for accountant and retry after access refresh.
Re-open the module, relink output artifacts, and verify final state.

faq.question: When should I rerun edit ledger transaction?
faq.answer: Rerun after correcting inputs or permissions, then validate output against expected records.

faq.question: How do I confirm edit ledger transaction is complete?
faq.answer: Use module validation checks, confirm resulting records, and verify supporting artifacts were saved.
